rules.name: netting-generic-plan
rules.explain: WITH RECURSIVE s AS ( (SELECT c.subportfolio FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.subportfolio IS NOT NULL AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) ORDER BY c.subportfolio LIMIT 1) UNION ALL SELECT (SELECT c.subportfolio FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.subportfolio > s.subportfolio AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL) ORDER BY c.subportfolio LIMIT 1) FROM s WHERE s.subportfolio IS NOT NULL ) SELECT subportfolio FROM s WHERE subportfolio IS NOT NULL

SELECT DISTINCT c.counterparty_parent FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT c.trade_group_type FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT c.contract_number FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL)

SELECT DISTINCT si.derivative_type FROM (SELECT DISTINCT c.security_id FROM opera.cloned_deal_ticket_table c WHERE c.tenant_id = :tenant AND c.business_unit = :bu AND c.lots_to_be_netted <> 0 AND (c.deal_status = 'Live' OR c.deal_status IS NULL)) s JOIN opera.security_info_table si ON si.tenant_id = :tenant AND si.business_unit = :bu AND si.security_id = s.security_id

expect.reason: counterparty list; 0.4 s to 8 s with a custom plan
a generic plan must not fall back to a table scan
